description: KYB company verification and business registry verification before paying, onboarding or contracting a company (vendor due diligence). One call checks US, UK, EU and Canadian sanctions (CSL incl. OFAC SDN), company registries (UK Companies House, Canada federal), legal entity status (GLEIF) and contractor licences (Quebec, Washington, Oregon). Returns allow / review / block, 0-100 risk score, dated sources and an Ed25519-signed receipt. Input: name, optional country, region. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base or Solana). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/verify-business with an x402 client.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, CA, GB

region.description: State/province code: WA, OR or QC enables contractor-licence checks
